findings.current: Though the Great Nation had only entered its third dynasty, the power wielded by its current Emperor equaled—or perhaps surpassed—that of Taizu, who had unified the realm.
findings.defect: “Third dynasty” changes the state’s history; the source says it has reached only its third generation.
findings.rationale: 삼대 counts generations, not successive dynasties.
findings.replacement: Though the Great Nation was only in its third generation, the power wielded by its current Emperor equaled—or perhaps surpassed—that of Taizu, who had unified the realm.
findings.source: 비록 이제 고작 삼대(三代)에 접어든 대국의 역사였으나

findings.current: Just like the future he had so little time left to see.
findings.defect: The comparison loses the darkness of the Emperor’s own future.
findings.rationale: The source compares the dark world beyond the gates to his remaining future, not merely to how little of it he will see.
findings.replacement: Just like his own future, brief and shrouded in darkness.
findings.source: 마치 얼마 남지 않은 자신의 미래처럼.

findings.defect: “Campaign” omits the defining point: this will be the first and last campaign the Emperor leads in person.
findings.rationale: 친정 specifically means a ruler personally taking the field.
findings.replacement: The first campaign he would lead in person—and the last.

findings.current: Gungseong, who had been riding quietly with the reins in hand, replied.
findings.defect: Uses a romanization instead of the established title.
findings.rationale: 궁성 is established as the Bow Saint.
findings.replacement: The Bow Saint, who had been riding quietly with the reins in hand, replied.
findings.source: 말고삐를 쥔 채 묵묵하게 나아가던 궁성이 말을 받았다.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it changes a dynastic fact and misses several consequential nuances.
